1h.conditional_adoption_rule: Adopt tau* for domain 1h only if, on FRESH Phase 003 synthetic draws, all hold: (i) FPR(d, tau*) Wilson upper <= alpha0=0.05; (ii) sub(d, tau*) <= 0.50 at the operating MDE; (iii) an EXP-005-style realistic candidate carrying an edge >= MDE(d, tau*) is detected with TPR >= 0.80. If any condition fails on fresh draws, retain the frozen strict reference tau=1.0 for that domain. Split note: EXP-010 (corrected pooled-OOS estimator) found this domain's gate MDE split-robust across single / walk-forward / purged-CV protocols. Per-instrument caveat: EXP-008 flags material per-instrument MDE heterogeneity for EURUSD; the headline is pooled-by-domain. Non-blindness: EXP-005 shows the strict gate is already an honest detection floor here, so any sub-tau=1.0 recommendation is a sensitivity-headroom choice, not a blindness remedy.
